corrections: Removed invented shape deformation as the primary form system.
Uses four existing CC0 Kenney character forms with measured geometry.
Each form gets the same 12 skin recipes by recompiling against its own native UV.
Custom images become shared palette recipes rather than being pasted into incompatible UVs.
Semantic animation buttons map to equivalent source clips per form.
All runtime materials are unlit and reduced to one 256x256 generated map.
